message.text:
Beginning to identify the two protocols serving MemoService and locate their registration files.

The two protocols are gRPC/gRPC-Gateway and ConnectRPC. Now locating the registration files for each.
I'll find where MemoService is registered for each of the two protocols.
v1.go shows REST HTTP via RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer and ConnectRPC via RegisterConnectHandlers/NewMemoServiceHandler. A third native gRPC server may also exist.

gRPC-Gateway (REST HTTP) — v1.go via RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer
ConnectRPC — connect_handler.go / connect_services.go via RegisterConnectHandlers

v1.go contains no native gRPC server registration; it only serves gRPC-Gateway and ConnectRPC. The two protocols are REST/HTTP JSON and ConnectRPC.

q19.
gRPC-Gateway — server/router/api/v1/v1.go
Connect — server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go

`RegisterGateway` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` mounts the REST gRPC-Gateway via `RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer` on `/api/v1/*`. Connect is registered in `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go` (`RegisterConnectHandlers` / `apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler`); per-RPC wrappers live in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go`.
